name: Escape Green
notes: Escape Green 0.1.0-r4. Double-tap Space (350 ms window, timed at keydown) starts flight; holding Space climbs in wall-clock time, Shift or C descends, and a Flying HUD chip plus toasts make the state obvious. ?debug shows an aggro readout (state, angry count, distance vs 40 m) and ?debug&coins=N grants coins (F8 grants +10); both are inert without ?debug. Phone-size touch controls sit above the hearts and hotbar. Retired biome ids, companion display names, the old camp barn landmark and its sign, a retired book item, an old service-worker comment, and a private art-folder path are stripped. HUD SVG icons are original to this project. Save schema: engine v5 plus Escape Green schema v1. IDB name and Workbox cacheId prefix stay escape-green. SW denylist unchanged. PROXY draw-call caps: High <=150, Low <=70 (Low target <=62). Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
